title: Approval identity prebinding repair
objective: Repair the approval-ID sequencing deadlock with one bounded, tested control-plane code change.
acceptance_summary: Prebound UUID is MAC-bound before contract hashing and remains non-authoritative until registered.

Registration idempotency includes canonical candidate payload hash: byte-identical payload replay remains valid, while a distinct payload with the same ID reaches the transaction and fails approval_id_collision without a loser mirror.
Recovery after an issued-but-unmirrored record is exact-binding, authenticated, read-only to authority, and exclusive-output.
